messages:
Lena Ortiz: Dropping a new direction for the playground: a floating micro-toolbar that appears when a response is hovered/focused. Contains 'Stop generation' (text + icon), a compact cost chip, and a kebab for secondary actions (Regenerate / Save to prompt library). Link to comps: https://redwood.internal/s/micro-toolbar-v1
Harpreet Singh: Nice pattern. Two immediate concerns: 1) floating controls might occlude text on small windows; 2) frequent cost updates during streaming could cause layout shift. Can we keep toolbar overlay non-blocking and debounce cost updates?
Miles Carter: For layout, toolbar should float outside of the message flow (position: absolute) so it doesn't push content. For streaming we should throttle cost updates to 350ms and animate numeric changes rather than reflowing. Backend can help by sending summarized snapshots instead of every chunk.
Asha Rao: Accessibility notes: keyboard-visible trigger (focusable area) that shows toolbar on focus. Cost chip should expose a dialog with role=dialog and aria-label="Cost details". Also ensure Stop has accessible name 'Stop generation' and visible focus ring. Color contrast for the chip needs to hit 4.5:1.
Tomoko Watanabe: Microcopy: show 'Cost' on the chip, not 'Estimate'. Non-technical testers found 'estimate' ambiguous. For the Regenerate menu item use 'Regenerate response' and include estimated cost inline in the dialog when available.
Lena Ortiz: Product decisions: 1) default behavior: Stop visible on toolbar, Regenerate in kebab; 2) cost chip opens a 'Cost details' panel with input/output/total tokens, model, and USD estimate; 3) throttle updates at 350ms on the frontend and accept summarized snapshots from the backend when `cost_streaming=true`.
ux-bot: Note posted: created ticket INF-4999 for backend to support `cost_streaming` flag and snapshot granularity. Figma file: https://figma.com/file/micro-toolbar-2026 (frames: playground/floating-toolbar/v1).
Harpreet Singh: Keyboard shortcuts: Escape to stop, Alt+R to regenerate (opt-in due to browser conflicts). Also add a toggle in settings to change the regenerate shortcut. Ensure we surface the shortcut in the tooltip for the kebab menu.
Miles Carter: Implementation detail: backend will emit `cost_snapshot` events with sequence numbers and a session_id so the client can ignore out-of-order snapshots. Will also include a `final_cost` event on stream end. PR targeted this week.
Asha Rao: A11y nit: make sure the cost details panel traps focus while open and restores focus to the cost chip on close. Use aria-modal and aria-describedby pointing to the cost breakdown header.
Tomoko Watanabe: UX nit: if estimated cost > $0.65 show a soft confirmation modal when a user selects Regenerate. Modal copy idea: "Regenerating may incur an additional charge (~$0.68). Continue?" Provide Proceed / Cancel. No hard block.
Lena Ortiz: We'll record analytics: `toolbar_shown`, `cost_panel_opened`, `regen_attempted`, `regen_confirmed`, `stop_via_toolbar`, `stop_via_shortcut`. Also add `high_cost_regen_prompt` with the estimated USD. 
ux-bot: Design token update: increased chip contrast and added high-contrast fallback token (figma tokens updated).
Harpreet Singh: Edge case: network reconnects mid-stream. Client should request a re-sync snapshot by sending `?resync=true` for the session. Backend will reply with the latest `cost_snapshot` sequence.
Miles Carter: Good call  will add idempotency and snapshots with seq numbers to the event contract.
Lena Ortiz: I'll update Figma with the focus states, add the a11y checklist, and post final frames. Tagging design & eng for review. Thanks all. :sparkles:
